supersedes: x-local-search-and-source-evidence-20261024: separate explicit profile lookup actions and single provider selection by media kind
Earlier no-automatic-second-provider rule is replaced by explicit dual-provider search after consent naming both destinations
Supported native resources open through existing platform workflows instead of always opening an external browser

rules: Automatically read only the original publisher's declared links, independent of provider search progress and action locking. Do not follow arbitrary low-score result publishers or infer authorship.
SauceNAO and Google Lens each run independently on the same frozen selection. Source URL versus sanitized pixels remains explicit; do not send account credentials or video contents.
Version remembered consent for both destinations; previous single-provider consent is not reused silently.
Each provider has its own results, status, manual verification, cancellation and original browser lifetime. First results remain usable while another provider runs or waits.
No results or extraction failure retains same-job original browser if created; opening it does not repeat upload.
Native indexed destination validation precedes app navigation. Exact supported targets reuse their existing app detail/creator flow. Opaque redirects and unsupported targets are not guessed.
Preserve archive identity, source context, privacy/generation cancellation, existing card/favorite/download semantics and resource limits.
Parallel agents implement and review offline; only root performs the bounded actual UI batch. No goal, publishing or data cleanup.

verification.liveEvidence: Isolated actual desktop: downloaded image search, simultaneous SauceNAO/Lens responses and same-job original browser for each. Actual Lens photo/title extraction repaired and verified with neutral-image host probe, then exact response replayed in production panel at wide/narrow sizes.
verification.limits: Authenticated publisher-link success and every supported platform destination have not been clicked end to end. Empty/failure rendering and navigation adapters have automated coverage; both original browsers were tested on successful actual responses. Opaque Google redirects remain external when no exact supported destination is known.

acceptance: No publisher lookup button; profile links automatically appear and pending lookup does not disable image search/results
Both service results render independently and same original browser remains inspectable on empty/failure
Late/cancelled/context-changed replies do not reappear; old consent is not broadened
Supported destinations open the intended existing app content
Wide and small layouts remain readable and keep close controls reachable
Actual app requests and navigation verified separately from offline synthetic fixtures
